verdict.rationale: Trivy is itself an official CLI. Documented commands include `trivy image` and `trivy k8s --report summary cluster`, it installs through common channels such as `brew install trivy` and `docker run aquasec/trivy`, and a probe confirms the CLI is documented in the official repo. Community users independently say it is easy to automate and to integrate into CI/CD. Missing for 10: no evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as documented machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output modes.
